theme: A travel day — East Hampton down to DC by rail, Maine tomorrow.
greeting: A quiet, open morning gives way to an afternoon on the rails: LIRR into the city, then the 3:16 Amtrak down to Washington, with an overnight in DC before tomorrow's late flight to Bangor. The girls are with Jen this stretch, so the trip is yours to make at your own pace.

schedule.title: LIRR from East Hampton
schedule.detail: Into the city via Jamaica, arriving early afternoon.

schedule.title: Amtrak to Washington, DC
schedule.detail: Moynihan/Penn Station to DC, ~3½ hrs; overnight in Washington.

inbox.noise: The rest is promotions and newsletters — Costco tips, Mattress Firm, bedding sales, a Morgan Stanley savings pitch, a couple of campaign emails, and the Portland Press Herald.
inbox.clear: No urgent, security, or job-search mail awaiting a reply.

resolved: Locked in the trip: Amtrak tickets to DC and tomorrow night's AA flight on to Bangor, and looped Mike in.
Cleared a few to-dos — thanked Sakai-san, mapped next steps with Shireen, and sorted the Vinalhaven sconces.

recipe.title: Cold avocado & cucumber soup
recipe.why: A cold, silky bowl for a hot travel day — cucumbers are at their August peak and it asks nothing of you at the end of a train ride south.

acts.line: An open morning — nothing was on the calendar before the train.
Amtrak from New York down to Washington, DC (in around 6:16).
Arrive in DC — the evening is your own.
